enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +10: Passive: +10 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Intelligence +6: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Transmutation Focus +4: +4 Equipment bonus to the DC of Transmutation spells.
Devotion +77: Passive: +77 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Fragmented: This item looks as though it is only one half of a greater item. Perhaps in the future it could be rejoined with its other half to reform the item in its original glory.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
